entities.name: Okina
entities.description: Ancient temple on Kamigawa, the oldest of the Jukai's shrines, considered the heart of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest whose oldest shrine is Okina.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: Great tree near which Okina stood.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War in which the Jukai kami turned violent against the monks.

entities.name: Dosan
entities.description: Monk who remained at Okina to defend the shrine with his trusted students.

entities.name: Seshiro
entities.description: Famous orochi leader who trained with the monks of Okina.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: Snake people who first encountered humans at Okina.

events.summary: When the Jukai kami turned violent, most monks refused to fight; many were killed or fled, leaving a handful to defend Okina.
events.quote: But when the Jukai forest kami turned violent, most of the monks refused to fight them.

events.summary: The first relevant encounter between humans and orochi takes place at Okina.
events.quote: the first relevant encounter between humans and orochi took place

events.summary: Seshiro trains with the monks of Okina in martial and spiritual arts.
events.quote: trained with the monks of Okina in both martial and spiritual arts

relations.note: Okina was the oldest of the Jukai's shrines.
relations.quote: The Okina Temple was the oldest of the Jukai 's shrines

relations.note: He was among those who remained to defend the shrine.
relations.quote: Among them were Dosan and his most trusted students.
